research_policy: Official venue, operator and destination sources. Suggested activity times are planning estimates. No tickets, hotel reservations, transfers or tables have been booked.

critical_corrections.claim: La traviata at La Scala on Monday 19 October, 20:00
critical_corrections.verdict: Wrong production; standard tickets sold out
critical_corrections.replacement: La Scala lists Giselle, a ballet, on 19 October 2026 at 20:00. The event page explicitly says Sold out. Published running time is approximately 2 hours 5 minutes including the interval, giving an approximate 22:05 finish. La traviata's 2026 run ended on 15 October. Treat La Scala as an optional ballet opportunity only if official returns become available.

critical_corrections.claim: Book an early Milan dinner at 17:30
critical_corrections.verdict: Does not fit the suggested restaurant's published service
critical_corrections.replacement: Al Mercante's official dinner service begins at 18:30 Monday–Saturday. It is now at Via Cesare Cantù 7, corner Piazza Pio XI. Reserve 18:30 and tell the restaurant about a 20:00 performance if you obtain a ticket; otherwise enjoy a normal early dinner and protect sleep before the 06:20 train.

critical_corrections.claim: St Augustine's baptism belongs to the Sant'Ambrogio visit
critical_corrections.verdict: Historical connection right, location must be distinguished
critical_corrections.replacement: Ambrose baptised Augustine in 387 in the Baptistery of San Giovanni alle Fonti, whose surviving remains are in the Duomo archaeological area. Sant'Ambrogio is a separate basilica, important for Ambrose's legacy and burial. Choose a Duomo ticket that explicitly includes the archaeological area or add the appropriate supplement; a rooftop combo alone does not necessarily include it.

critical_corrections.verdict: Confirmed for October 2026, with a useful missing cutoff
critical_corrections.replacement: Garden opens daily 10:00–18:00; house museum follows those hours but closes Tuesdays. Thursday 22 and Friday 23 are normally open. Last entry is 30 minutes before closing, hence 17:30. Reach it around 16:00 for an unhurried visit rather than arriving at the cutoff.

critical_corrections.claim: La Vista lake-facing dinner in late October
critical_corrections.verdict: Season fits, table and exact date remain unconfirmed
critical_corrections.replacement: Albergo Milano advertises dinner April through late October, closed Tuesdays, from 19:00. Italian and English pages differ on closing time, so use 19:00 and ask for an indoor window table on 22 October; terrace weather and a specific table are not guaranteed. Dinner will be after the best daylight, so enjoy the lakeside view before dinner.

critical_corrections.claim: La Vineria di San Mattia is a simple city-centre hotel stop
critical_corrections.verdict: Hill property with an address ambiguity to resolve
critical_corrections.replacement: La Vineria is part of the Corte San Mattia family farm in Verona's northern hills. Its own site lists Via Sommavalle 1 and says cellar rooms are about 300 m from the main agriturismo; the main Corte San Mattia site lists Via Santa Giuliana 2/A. Ask the host which entrance and check-in point match your booking, then arrange station transfers. Do not use the main farm's marketing distance from the city as a walking time to the Arena or station.

The 2026 Arena Opera Festival ran 12 June–12 September. The indoor Teatro Filarmonico has its own programme; the published October opera/ballet double bill starts Sunday 25 October, after this itinerary leaves Verona. Do not promise an Arena or Filarmonico opera on 23 October.

Sant'Ambrogio sightseeing Monday–Saturday 10:00–12:00 and 14:30–18:00, subject to liturgy. General church opening hours are longer; do not confuse them with tourist visiting hours. 14:30 on Monday is valid, but fitting a full cathedral/roof visit and lunch beforehand may make it rushed.

La Scala's detailed box-office guidelines describe limited-view/no-view balcony tickets, normally €10, 80 for non-opera events such as ballet. Normally register in person three hours before the show (17:00 for 20:00), with ID and Scala customer code; sales begin two hours before. Both travellers must appear. Availability, adjacent seats and a usable view are not guaranteed; this is a poor default for a romantic ballet evening and consumes the late afternoon. Prefer official full-view returns, or skip.

The church operator lists San Zeno's March–October Saturday visitor hours as 09:00–18:00. Visit Verona additionally publishes a specific 24 October exception: 09:00–14:30 and 16:30–18:00. Use 09:00–10:00 in either case. Services can suspend visits. Single-church admission is published as €4, bought on site; no advance reservation is required.

Look for the medieval bronze doors, Mantegna's San Zeno altarpiece, and the crypt associated with Verona's patron saint. These make San Zeno the strongest single Verona church for your Christian-history interests.
The Duomo's official visit information says large bags are not allowed. Arrange luggage drop at your guesthouse before sightseeing; early drop/check-in must be confirmed with the property.

Linate Shuttle directly connects the airport and Milano Centrale, stopping at Piazza Luigi di Savoia. This is a useful arrival route for a guesthouse by Centrale. Check the operator's actual 19 October departure timetable; allow 60–90 minutes from landing through airport exit, waiting, traffic and the final walk as a planning buffer, not a guaranteed journey time.

recommended_days.headline: Augustine's baptism, Ambrose's basilica and an early Milanese dinner
recommended_days.pace: Two substantial visits; the roof is optional. The next morning's 06:20 train makes sleep valuable.

schedule.activity: Arrive LIN on your stated flight; exact flight operation remains traveller-supplied.
Shuttle or taxi toward Centrale, drop luggage at Via Ponte Seveso 18 if the guesthouse agrees, and have a simple lunch. Do not buy a tight 12:30 timed ticket off an inbound flight.

Duomo interior and San Giovanni alle Fonti archaeological area. Read the baptism site as a real place in Augustine's story. If you prefer skyline views, allow another 45–60 minutes for the roof and shorten the rest of the afternoon; ticket times, access and availability must be selected on the official portal.
Sant'Ambrogio: atrium, Romanesque interior and crypt if open. Its Monday tourist window is 14:30–18:00, with worship taking priority.

Dinner at Al Mercante or a convenient neighbourhood restaurant, then pack for the train. Ask what Milanese dishes are on the day's menu rather than assuming risotto, ossobuco and cotoletta are all offered.

recommended_days.optional_music: Only if suitable official tickets become available: Giselle ballet at La Scala, 20:00–approximately 22:05. Arrive around 19:15; a 18:30 dinner must be explicitly arranged as a short pre-theatre meal. Mainstream seats were sold out when checked. The more relaxed default is dinner and bed, with vocal music pursued in Venice.
recommended_days.rain_plan: The cathedral, archaeology and basilica work well in rain. Drop rooftop terraces first if weather or delays intervene.
skip: Last Supper on this compressed arrival day without an existing reservation
Treating La traviata as an available performance
The entire Duomo complex, a long lunch, Sant'Ambrogio and a ticket queue in one afternoon

recommended_days.headline: Keep the lake evening for the two of you
recommended_days.anchor: Villa Monastero garden, waterfront and La Vista
recommended_days.pace: The rail journey from St. Moritz uses much of the day. Stay in Varenna; avoid adding a ferry excursion to Bellagio.

schedule.activity: Walk or arrange transfer to Albergo Milano, leave luggage, then choose activities around actual arrival rather than an invented rail connection.

Villa Monastero garden and house if arrival allows. Both are normally open Thursday 10:00–18:00; final entry 17:30. The garden is the priority for lake views. If you arrive after 16:30, shorten the house visit or skip it.
Waterfront and Passeggiata degli Innamorati; sit with a drink, then Piazza San Giorgio. Church interior is opportunistic because a reliable date-specific schedule has not been established.

La Vista at your hotel: request an indoor lake-facing window table and ask what local lake fish is in season. Published late-October season fits Thursday; exact operation and table require the restaurant's confirmation.

recommended_days.rain_plan: House museum, a leisurely coffee and a window-table dinner. No boat trip is needed.
recommended_days.friday_morning: Breakfast and a short waterfront stroll. An 11:35 train allows only a compressed visit after the villa's 10:00 opening, so prioritise the villa on Thursday and be at Varenna-Esino around 11:15 if that service is confirmed. Allow extra time uphill with luggage.

recommended_days.headline: Let the vineyard stay be the special experience
recommended_days.anchor: Farm views and a host-led wine experience, subject to availability
recommended_days.pace: After your stated 15:17 arrival, choose either the farm evening or the city walk; doing both with check-in creates repeated hill transfers.

schedule.activity: Arrive Verona Porta Nuova if the original train itinerary is reconfirmed. Pre-arrange a taxi to the exact La Vineria check-in entrance; leave 30–45 minutes in the plan for meeting the driver, traffic and check-in, an estimate rather than a fare or running-time quote.

Enjoy the farm's views in daylight and ask about a short wine tasting, farm walk or meeting a family producer. The property advertises wine experiences and produces Valpolicella, Amarone and Recioto; no particular 23 October session is confirmed.

Reserve dinner at the family farm's restaurant if it is operating. This best uses a hillside stay and avoids another return taxi. Ask the host about Friday kitchen hours and the walk between your room, tasting and restaurant.

recommended_days.city_alternative: If the city matters more: check in, then taxi to Ponte Pietra, walk toward Piazza delle Erbe and Piazza Bra/Arena exterior, and dine at Al Pompiere at 19:30. Arrange the return taxi before dinner. This replaces the farm dinner/tasting, and a separate Castel San Pietro ascent is optional only if time and energy allow.
recommended_days.rain_plan: Indoor tasting if confirmed, otherwise a long meal at the farm; keep city sightseeing for Saturday morning.

recommended_days.headline: Protect San Zeno, then move on without rushing

schedule.activity: Check out after breakfast; taxi from the hill property. Plan luggage storage before a church visit or go directly to the station and use a verified deposit service. Host/driver timings and luggage arrangements need confirmation.
San Zeno Maggiore, with the bronze doors, crypt and Mantegna altarpiece. Saturday 24 October is published as open from 09:00, with an afternoon interruption; a morning visit avoids that issue.

Short walk via Castelvecchio/Ponte Scaligero toward Piazza Bra for the Arena exterior and a coffee. Do not add an Arena interior tour unless you have chosen a later train and checked its admission conditions.

Collect luggage and board a confirmed Verona Porta Nuova–Venezia Mestre train. Choose an actual departure with at least 30–45 minutes to retrieve bags and reach the platform after sightseeing. No specific train time has been verified; an early train before roughly 11:00 means dropping the city walk, and a very early departure means dropping San Zeno.

recommended_days.lunch_alternative: Al Pompiere opens lunch at 12:30, so it requires a later onward train. Do not promise this lunch and an early Venice arrival together.

food_shortlist.name: Ristorante Al Mercante
food_shortlist.address: Via Cesare Cantù 7, corner Piazza Pio XI
food_shortlist.why: Convenient to the Duomo and a workable 18:30 dinner. Traditional Milanese foods to ask about include saffron risotto, ossobuco and cotoletta; the restaurant says its menu changes daily, so dishes are not guaranteed.

food_shortlist.name: La Vista at Albergo Milano
food_shortlist.why: A romantic dinner in your own hotel, with indoor lake-facing windows. Ask about seasonal lake fish; do not assume perch is available or promise a sunset terrace dinner in October.
food_shortlist.hours: April to late October, evenings from 19:00, Tuesdays closed; English and Italian versions differ on closing time

food_shortlist.name: Corte San Mattia family farm restaurant / wine experience
food_shortlist.why: Highest-fit use of your accommodation: local wine and a chance to talk to the people producing it. The farm advertises restaurant bookings, cellar experiences and wine-bar tastings. Confirm the Friday service and exact room-to-restaurant distance with your host.

food_shortlist.name: Trattoria Al Pompiere
food_shortlist.why: A good city-dinner alternative. Published seasonal menu includes Lessinia salami, Amarone-braised beef cheek and sbrisolona. Its present risotto is not risotto all'Amarone, so do not attribute that dish to this venue without reconfirming.
